def _order(api, customer, items):
    return api.orders.handle_create({"customer_id": customer, "items": items}).body["order_id"]


def test_unknown_customer(shop):
    r = shop.insights.handle_order_history("nope")

    r = shop.insights.handle_order_history("c1")

    assert r.body["customer_id"] == "c1"

        {"order_id": a, "status": "cancelled", "total_cents": 300},
